content.short: CoinCodex tracks prices, market caps and charts for tens of thousands of coins across hundreds of exchanges.
content.description: CoinCodex pulls trades from hundreds of exchanges and builds volume-weighted prices for a very long list of tokens. Alongside live quotes, it has technical analysis charts, price alerts, a portfolio tracker, model-based price predictions and a news feed. Everything is available on the website and in iOS and Android apps, and the platform has expanded into stocks and other markets too. Its price prediction pages now cover stocks and forex as well as crypto, and it adds converters, calculators and a press release section for projects.
